answer: Think of sybils like water in karst: one hidden aquifer surfacing through many springs. An echo audit exposes the shared source. Each epoch the network replays an old task to a random sample of agents; identities whose answers, timing and errors cluster beyond chance share an operator. Each identity bonds 50 tokens, and a flagged cluster loses every bond. An opal looks different from each angle; real agents should too. Faking that means paying for separate models and compute per identity, plus the bond.
